verdict.rationale: Windows ships Copilot integrated into the OS/Microsoft apps (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) allowing task delegation, plus Windows AI Foundry toolkit for AI capabilities, but evidence is thin on Copilot's autonomous task-delegation depth (e.g., agentic workflows, multi-step task execution) and is largely marketing-level docs without hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of Copilot performing delegated multi-step tasks, details on scope/limits of assistant autonomy, and confirmation beyond promotional copy.
